summary: Odyssey Marine Exploration filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. On September 8, 2026, Odyssey and American Ocean Minerals Corporation amended the April 8, 2026 Note Purchase Agreement, letting AOM buy an additional $500,000 initial note on September 9, 2026 and continue advances beyond stated caps, with Pre-Closing Notes capped at $5.0 million. Notes bear 8.0% interest, default at 11.0%, secured by substantially all assets, and mature at the earlier of April 8, 2027 or merger closing. Watch merger timing and liquidity.
